About the lab

An independent lab for digital things.

Wonder Box Lab is an independent product and technology brand. We design and build digital products with a simple standard: it should feel worth opening.

Games✳Apps✳AI tools✳SaaS✳Wonder

“The box is not the product. What's inside is.”

We are a product brand, not a genre. Games are simply where the lab began.

Wonder Box Lab started with a love of small, complete experiences — the kind of game you can pick up for a minute and still feel something. That same standard applies to everything else we want to make: apps that respect attention, AI tools that keep people in charge, and software that removes friction instead of adding it.

We are independent, which means we can follow the idea instead of the trend. It also means we take our time. The catalog should stay small until each product has earned its place.

There is no published release calendar for the future. When a new box is ready to open, it will appear here.

The work

Made with intention.

Three ideas that shape how products get made here.

01

Start with a feeling.

Every product begins with the moment we want someone to have, not the feature list.

02

Sweat the invisible parts.

Fast loads, clear words, forgiving edges. Craft is what you notice only when it is missing.

03

Leave room to grow.

We build small, deliberate systems that can become more without losing what made them work.

A small promise

No imaginary products. No borrowed credentials.

Everything on this site describes work that exists or a direction we are genuinely exploring. If a product is in development, it says so. If there is no public download, there is no fake button.
